description:
My boyfriend announced his marriage to me. And that too... to another woman. That's how our four-year relationship crumbled in an instant. To make matters worse, he proposed she become his mistress. Do-Eun refused and they broke up. Later, while on a business trip to Hawaii, Do-Eun met a man with exotic looks named Ian on the beach. Feeling overwhelmed by the intensity of their relationship, Do-Eun continued seeing him under a pseudonym.

 *“Mo...Ana. My name is Moana.”*

They spent passionate nights together, neither knowing the other's name or age, considering it a fleeting encounter destined to be just a memory of Hawaii. Until he reappeared. 

*“Long time no see, Moana. Or should I call you Director Eun Do-Eun now?”*

(Source: Naver, translated)
